title: Girls' Last Tour
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Two girls, Chito and Yuuri, ride a small half-track vehicle through the snowy ruins of a city destroyed by a long-past war, searching for food, fuel and spare parts. Episodic chapters follow their meals, conversations and occasional meetings with other survivors and strange creatures as they climb toward the top of the city.
life_message: It holds up living in the present, companionship and small daily pleasures as enough to give life meaning even when the future is uncertain.

content.note: Civilization ended in war; a rifle is fired and a robot destroyed with explosives; no gore described.
Bleak, lonely post-apocalyptic mood; questions of death and an uncertain ending.
No romance or sexual content reported.
The two girls drink found alcohol and get drunk in one chapter (Wikipedia).
Despair and the meaning of life discussed calmly; no self-harm reported.
Young characters drink alcohol and handle firearms in a survival setting.
